name: Desktop control (text-only GUI automation)
description: Let a text-only agent see and drive the user's desktop: list and focus windows, read on-screen controls and text with coordinates (UI Automation or OCR), click, type, send hotkeys, open apps, and paste tables into Excel/SPSS/Prism.

requires.external: Windows 10/11 for `inspect` (UI Automation); macOS needs Accessibility + Screen Recording permission; Linux needs X11 + wmctrl. The BioDSH env pack '电脑控制' installs the packages.
